Preserving an existing application process does not expressly establish an enduring exclusion from substantive relief. The formula fixes pending status at commencement and excludes the associated change even after possible approval, withdrawal or replacement; that extension needs authority.

The two unbound dependency IDs have no identifying metadata. Neither can safely be assigned to a particular missing authority.
Home-jurisdiction compliance and the product-feature and policy classifications remain supplied judgments. Their substantive correctness is not established by the Boolean formula.
FALSE means only that the proposed relief test is not satisfied. It does not establish an approval duty or non-compliance; TRUE does not discharge notification, filing or post-vetting obligations.
